# v2rayF

> Cross-platform V2Ray / Xray proxy and TUN VPN client for Windows, macOS, Linux, and Android.

This file helps LLMs and automated agents understand the project quickly. Humans should start with [README.md](README.md) and [docs/GETTING_STARTED.md](docs/GETTING_STARTED.md).

## Summary

- **Name:** v2rayF
- **Owner:** drmikecrypto
- **Repo:** https://github.com/drmikecrypto/v2rayF
- **License:** MIT
- **UI:** Avalonia (.NET 10)
- **Data plane:** Xray-core (bundled in release zips; not committed to git)
- **Platforms:** Windows (x64/arm64), macOS (x64/arm64), Linux (x64/arm64), Android (arm64). No iOS product.
- **Protocols:** VMess, VLESS (REALITY / Vision / Vision+TLS), Shadowsocks, Trojan, SOCKS — transports TCP/WS/gRPC/H2/HTTPUpgrade/xHTTP/mKCP/QUIC
- **Latest downloads:** https://github.com/drmikecrypto/v2rayF/releases/latest
- **1.4 highlights:** encrypted secrets at rest, `.v2rayf` vault export/import, Adaptive Survive, hardened updater (host allowlist + SHA256 + Zip-Slip), Secure Share LAN bind + vault-gated copy, agile Smart Connect probes, broad share-link/stream matrix

## What it is for

Privacy and anti-censorship proxy use: import `vless://` / `vmess://` / `ss://` / `trojan://` links or HTTPS subscriptions, connect via system proxy or TUN/VPN, with optional Smart Connect, Adaptive Survive, multipath balancing, DNS-through-proxy, IPv6 block, kill switch (Windows Firewall + Android VpnService hold), Secure Share (LAN SOCKS/HTTP), and encrypted profile vault.

## Key paths

| Path | Role |
|------|------|
| `src/v2rayF.Core/` | Models, Xray config builder, latency, stores, orchestration services |
| `src/v2rayF/` | Shared Avalonia UI and ViewModels |
| `src/v2rayF.Desktop/` | Desktop host, system proxy, Windows kill switch |
| `src/v2rayF.Android/` | Android VpnService, Java ProcessBuilder Xray host |
| `scripts/package-all.ps1` | Desktop release packaging |
| `scripts/package-android-release.ps1` | Android APK zip packaging |
| `docs/` | User-facing tips (routing, Secure Share, Sentinel QA) |

## Important commands

```bash
dotnet run --project src/v2rayF.Desktop/v2rayF.Desktop.csproj
pwsh -File scripts/package-all.ps1
pwsh -File scripts/package-android-release.ps1
```
